note: What each vertical of this network IS ABOUT, stated positively. scripts/validators/validate_vertical_topic_admission.js admits a route only when its subject shows affinity to the contract of the vertical it is filed under. This is deliberately an ALLOWLIST of subjects, not a blocklist of bad examples: a blocklist of today's off-topic pages ('IT degree', 'hair transplant Istanbul') would pass tomorrow's off-topic page unchanged. The class being caught is 'a route whose subject has no relationship to its vertical', and only a positive definition of the vertical can catch that class.
how_anchors_are_matched: Each anchor is a STEM, matched case-insensitively against word-starts in the route slug and the page title. 'neuro' therefore matches neurofeedback, neurologist and neuropsychological; 'implant' matches implants. Stems are chosen to be unambiguous subject markers for their vertical - words that a page about that vertical is overwhelmingly likely to contain and a page about something else is not.
maintenance: Add an anchor when the network legitimately expands into a new sub-subject and a correct page is being rejected. Do NOT add anchors to make a specific failing route pass; that inverts the contract into the blocklist it exists to avoid. Anchors are per-vertical, and an anchor shared by every vertical (e.g. 'cost') is worthless as a discriminator and must not be added.
